responsibility: Implements the C-family front ends’ -fdump-ada-spec facility by traversing C/C++ declarations, types, and selected preprocessor macros and emitting equivalent Ada package specifications (.ads files). It collects referenced source entities, queries C++-specific properties through a callback API, formats GENERIC trees and macro definitions into Ada syntax, manages package naming and required with-clauses, and writes one Ada spec per source file for interoperation/documentation rather than normal compilation.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for Ada spec dumping: it contains the traversal, formatting, macro collection, package/.ads file emission, and callback use to query C++ properties, whereas c-ada-spec.h only declares the callback enum and public entry points for invoking that machinery.
